ms.report:
Milestone 2: Collections: Curation & Development
(A) Native-Asset Database: We curated the library collections associated with our project, coded each by them, and organized them into a spreadsheet database.
(B) Dedicated Collections Pages: On our project homepage, we have developed dedicated pages for each area (12) of the library collections.
(C) New Assets created and added to Collections: These include assets within the collections at $learning, as well as our template for building a Library Card token, which is an on-chain compliment to the website. 
(D) Templates for Users to Create Native Assets: create a slideshow instruction guide for people learning JSON metadata, as well as a template example for them to follow in building their own. 
(E) Open-Source Toolbox: The creative tools section of the library was developed to include open-source assets that are publically available for people to use in creative or commercial ways. 
(F) Collections Marketing: Regular attendance of Twitter spaces and in-person conference events to discuss our project. 

Milestone overview video can be found here: https://youtu.be/KwSowo3FGl0

Milestone powerpoint can be found here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1t22hin5ND3Z9PlXu1RoRpxcrzCqrbRX7Puq_woEBoEw/edit?usp=sharing

Project Summary
The Alexandria Project has created thelibrary.fun, which is a platform for onboarding & education where anyone can learn about native assets on Cardano and create them yourself. Our emphasis is on assets that contain historical and educational content, as well as making it easy to create on Cardano! .
